segments.text: Please complete the registration carefully and mention one of the following in the Remarks section:
•⁠ ⁠Follow Normal Chanting Rules  OR •⁠ ⁠Following the Rules with Parikshit Bhaiya + Number of Days
The Sadhana will be conducted daily from 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM. The prescribed Sadhana rules will be applicable during this period.
All enrolled Sadhana aspirants are requested to complete their meal before 7:00 PM.
After 7:00 PM, all food and beverages, including milk, are to be avoided. Only plain water (including warm water) may be consumed.
Consumption of non-vegetarian food is permitted. However, if you are able to avoid it during the Sadhana period, it is encouraged.

Those who wish to observe the strict Sadhana discipline along with Parikshit Bhaiya should have only one meal before 7:00 PM. After 7:00 PM, all food and beverages, including milk, are to be avoided. Only plain water (including warm water) may be consumed.
Chanting should continue without interruption, even while travelling or from any location.
There are no restrictions on shaving, getting a haircut, or trimming/cutting nails during the Sadhana period.
